skillset.skill: 60s CT - 8000% Fire DMG (Physical). Reduce enemies' DMG resistance by 20% for 10s. If user is Fire, reduce enemies' DMG resistance by an additional 10%. If user is Human, reduce enemies' DMG resistance by an additional 10%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Shizu, increase own DMG, Heal Amount, and HP Recovery Amount by 30% (excluding Lifesteal). Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
